name: Crave Balance
subtitle: Daily metabolic & craving support

formats.name: Crave Balance · sticks
formats.note: Four dollars more because pre-measured film costs more than a jar — not because it is better.

formats.name: Crave Balance · subscription
formats.note: Inositol only works taken daily, so this is the honest default.

formats.name: Two jars, sixty days
formats.note: The shortest honest test of the formula. The only bundle we sell.

ingredients.name: Myo-inositol
ingredients.long: The base of the formula. Supports insulin signalling, normal glucose metabolism and a healthy menstrual cycle. Dosed at the level used in the literature, not a token amount.

ingredients.name: D-chiro-inositol
ingredients.long: Paired with myo at 40:1 — the physiological plasma ratio, and the one used in the trials people actually cite. More is not better here.

ingredients.name: Inositol ratio
ingredients.short: The ratio used in the published trials
ingredients.long: It is the approximate physiological plasma ratio, and the ratio used in the trials most often cited.

ingredients.name: L-theanine
ingredients.long: For the part of a craving that isn't hunger. Supports a calm, focused state without sedation — which is why there is no caffeine in here to fight it.

ingredients.name: Chromium picolinate
ingredients.long: An essential trace mineral that supports macronutrient and glucose metabolism. Picolinate for absorption; 200 mcg because that is the studied range.

ingredients.name: Saffron extract
ingredients.long: Standardized Crocus sativus stigma extract, for emotional wellbeing and the snacking that follows a hard afternoon. The most expensive gram in the jar.

excluded.name: Berberine
excluded.reason: GI tolerability at an effective dose, CYP3A4 interaction profile, mechanism outside this formula's job.

excluded.name: Caffeine
excluded.reason: You do not need a spike at 3pm; you need the edge taken off. It would also fight the theanine.

excluded.name: Added fiber
excluded.reason: Texture, and an honest dose we could not fit in one scoop.

excluded.name: Proprietary blends
excluded.reason: A blend exists so the split cannot be checked. Once you have one you can no longer publish a dose card.

supplementFacts.status: DRAFT — must be produced by the contract manufacturer and cleared by regulatory counsel before print or publication.
supplementFacts.otherIngredients: Natural raspberry flavor, citric acid, steviol glycosides.

directions.title: Dissolve one level scoop in 250–300 ml of water
directions.detail: Stir; it clears in a few seconds.

directions.title: Once a day, with a meal
directions.detail: Most people take it with lunch or in the early afternoon.

directions.title: Daily, without gaps
directions.detail: Inositol is a consistency ingredient, not an as-needed one.
